177:t_1:329.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Not just me. $$ティファ$$ and $$パーラ$$ are with me, too.」

177:t_1:330.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you... the pilot of that $$ガンダム$$ with whiskers on its cheeks...?」

177:t_1:331.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's the $$ガンダムＤＸ$$. I'm its pilot, $$ガロード・ラン$$.」

177:t_1:332.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And these are my companions, $$ティファ・アディール$$ and $$パーラ・シス$$.」

177:t_1:333.en:
$$ティファ$$
「It's nice to meet you.」

177:t_1:334.en:
$$パーラ$$
「I pilot the $$Ｇファルコン$$ and support $$ガロード$$'s $$ダブルエックス$$.」

177:t_1:335.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ガロード$$ and the others fought alongside us in $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

177:t_1:336.en:
$$シン$$
「Aren't $$ジャミル$$, $$ウィッツ$$, $$ロアビィ$$, and the others here?」

177:t_1:337.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We got separated in the so-called $$新世時空震動$$, and we're still apart.」

177:t_1:338.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Knowing them, I'm sure they're safe, though.」

177:t_1:339.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The $$新世時空震動$$ threw us into the $$残されの海$$. The $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet picked us up, and we worked as handymen there.」

177:t_1:340.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What's this $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet?」

177:t_1:341.en:
$$甲児$$
「Apparently, $$翠の地球$$ is mostly based on $$ＵＣＷ$$, but several other worlds have fused with it...」

177:t_1:342.en:
$$甲児$$
「The $$残されの海$$ is one of them. People there form fleets and live on the sea.」

177:t_1:343.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「The $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet is one of those.」

177:t_1:344.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$c saved us when pirates attacked.」

177:t_1:345.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you from that fleet...?」

177:t_1:346.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Yes! I'm $$エイミー$$. Nice to meet you.」

177:t_1:347.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'm $$ピニオン$$... a repairman. Well, I'm counting on you.」

177:t_1:349.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, hey... You're not looking down on us as country bumpkins, are you?」

177:t_1:351.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Knock it off, $$ピニオン$$. You're scaring $$ティファ$$.」

177:t_1:353.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Sorry, $$ティファ$$. First impressions matter if you don't want people looking down on you.」

177:t_1:354.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Honestly...! What if they think everyone in the $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet is like that!?」

177:t_1:355.en:
$$甲児$$
「The $$残されの海$$ became part of $$翠の地球$$ through the $$新世時空震動$$, but life at sea kept contact with other civilizations limited.」

177:t_1:356.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Well... Basically, our mechanical technology's a little behind yours.」

177:t_1:357.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「But I'll learn about it in $c and improve both my repair skills and myself as a man.」

177:t_1:358.en:
$$シン$$
「Your technology's behind...? Then what's that black robot?」

177:t_1:359.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The person near it... They're from the $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet, right?」

177:t_1:360.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That machine's called $$チェインバー#robot$$... It's a little special.」

177:t_1:361.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$! Come over here so I can introduce you to everyone!」

177:t_1:364.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Does $c tend to attract people like that...?)

177:t_1:365.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can hear you, $$シン$$, $$バナージ$$.」

177:t_1:367.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm looking after $$レド$$. I won't tolerate thoughtless remarks.」

177:t_1:368.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(It seems $$宗介$$, like $n, is starting to dislike being called the quiet type.)

177:t_1:369.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, Sergeant... Why don't you hurry up and introduce our Ensign to everyone?」

177:t_1:373.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I infer it is a rite in which one states one's name and affiliation to demonstrate a lack of hostile intent toward the group.」

177:t_1:375.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. I will demonstrate an introduction.」

177:t_1:376.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am unit number K6821, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. I am equipped with a $$パイロット支援啓発インターフェイス$$.」

177:t_1:377.en:
$$バナージ$$
「An interface... So its AI is what's talking...」

177:t_1:378.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Now it's your turn, $$レド$$.」

177:t_1:379.en:
$$レド$$
「I am Ensign $$レド$$ of the 《$$人類銀河同盟$$》.」

177:t_1:380.en:
$$シン$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$...? Aren't you from the $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet?」

177:t_1:381.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「We salvaged $$レド$$ and the tin can from the bottom of the $$残されの海$$ just recently.」

177:t_1:382.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「My name is $$チェインバー#pilot$$. I reject the designation 'tin can'.」

177:t_1:383.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're too rigid. That's exactly why I want to call you a tin can.」

177:t_1:384.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ apparently operates near the galactic center, fighting monsters called 《$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$》.」

177:t_1:385.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$レド$$ got caught in a $$時空震動$$ and came to Earth, but that Alliance is a little unusual from our perspective...」

177:t_1:386.en:
$$宗介$$
「Fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is their one absolute value. People of no use to the war effort are not allowed to exist.」

177:t_1:389.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's enough, $$バナージ$$. In a multiverse, we must also accept values different from our own.」

177:t_1:390.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's rich, coming from someone who had such trouble adjusting to school life...」

177:t_1:391.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$ was confused by life in the fleet at first, too. But you learned the language and got used to it, didn't you?」

177:t_1:395.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I understand... He seemed like the quiet type because he hadn't adjusted to life on Earth yet.」

177:t_1:396.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't use the term 'quiet type', $$カミーユ$$.」

177:t_1:398.en:
$$シン$$
「But after finally adjusting to life in the fleet, why did you join $c?」

177:t_1:399.en:
$$レド$$
「...I joined to fight $$サイデリアル$$.」

177:t_1:401.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ that $$レド$$ belonged to apparently fought $$サイデリアル$$ as well.」

177:t_1:402.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Correct. Their sphere of influence is vast, and armed clashes with the Alliance occur frequently.」

177:t_1:403.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you're trying to carry out that mission on Earth, too...」

177:t_1:404.en:
$$レド$$
「That is not my only reason.」

177:t_1:405.en:
$$レド$$
「I... came to Earth, met $$エイミー$$ and the others, and learned many things.」

177:t_1:406.en:
$$レド$$
「Then I learned the world was much wider. So I... wanted to learn about it.」

177:t_1:407.en:
$$エイミー$$
「And $$ピニオン$$ and I came along.」

177:t_1:408.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「That's right. Me and the tin can are counting on you.」
